description: Call this when the user asks what caused a recent crash or flush, about liquidation cascades, or who got liquidated. Returns auto-detected cascade incidents: when, total notional flushed, long/short split, which coins led, and BTC's move during the window. Totals are an honestly-labeled lower bound from a real liquidation tape.
name: get_liquidation_cascades
title: Auto-detected liquidation cascades (forensic case file)
